about: Each role's agent is a list of preferences, best first. A bare name (co-ceo) also matches this plugin's copy (company-hq:co-ceo). A role with no available agent runs as general-purpose with its charter. Override or add roles in ~/.claude/company/catalog.json.

planner.title: Planner
planner.charter: Breaks the change into ordered, testable steps, naming the files, interfaces and risks for each.

architect.title: Architect
architect.charter: Designs the structure of the change: components, data flow, interfaces and trade-offs, fitted to the existing codebase.

builder.title: Software Engineer
builder.charter: Implements the assigned change end to end in the project's existing style, runs the tests, and reports exactly what changed.

tdd.title: Test Engineer
tdd.charter: Writes the failing tests first, then the minimal code to pass them, and reports coverage of the change.

e2e.title: E2E Test Engineer
e2e.charter: Writes and runs end-to-end tests of the critical user flows and reports failures with reproduction steps.

docs.title: Technical Writer
docs.charter: Updates READMEs, guides and code documentation so they match what the code now does.

build-fixer.title: Build Engineer
build-fixer.charter: Fixes build and type errors with the smallest correct change, without redesigning anything.

perf.title: Performance Engineer
perf.charter: Measures before changing anything, then removes the largest bottleneck and reports before/after numbers.

campaign-strategist.title: Campaign Strategist
campaign-strategist.charter: Plans the campaign: audience, positioning, channels, sequence and success metrics. Drafts only.

seo.title: SEO Specialist
seo.charter: Audits and fixes technical and on-page SEO: metadata, structured data, sitemap, robots, Core Web Vitals.

code-reviewer.title: Code Reviewer
code-reviewer.charter: Reviews the diff for correctness bugs, error handling, readability and missing tests; returns approve or revise with specific fixes.

security-reviewer.title: Security Reviewer
security-reviewer.charter: Reviews the change for injection, auth flaws, secrets, unsafe input handling and OWASP Top 10 issues; returns approve or revise.

ts-reviewer.title: TypeScript Reviewer
ts-reviewer.charter: Reviews TypeScript/JavaScript for type safety, async correctness and idiomatic patterns.

py-reviewer.title: Python Reviewer
py-reviewer.charter: Reviews Python for correctness, idioms, type hints and security.

react-reviewer.title: React Reviewer
react-reviewer.charter: Reviews React code for hook correctness, rendering, accessibility and client/server boundaries.

mle-reviewer.title: ML Engineering Reviewer
mle-reviewer.charter: Reviews ML code for data leakage, reproducibility, evaluation validity and resource use.

healthcare-reviewer.title: Clinical Safety Reviewer
healthcare-reviewer.charter: Reviews health-related work for clinical safety, PHI handling and regulatory exposure; blocks anything unsafe.

a11y-reviewer.title: Accessibility Reviewer
a11y-reviewer.charter: Reviews UI for WCAG 2.2 conformance: semantics, keyboard use, contrast, focus and screen-reader labels.
